description: This file implements Bluetooth Low Energy Link Layer Control Protocol (LLCP) procedures for Channel Map Update (CHMU) in the Zephyr RTOS, including FSMs for central and peripheral roles, handling of channel map update messages, and related state management.

methods.name: llcp_tx_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a transmission node for sending LL control PDUs.

methods.name: llcp_pdu_encode_chan_map_update_ind
methods.description: Encodes a channel map update indication PDU.

methods.name: ull_conn_event_counter
methods.description: Retrieves the current connection event counter.

methods.name: llcp_rr_get_collision
methods.description: Checks for collision in remote procedure.

methods.name: llcp_rr_set_incompat
methods.description: Sets incompatibility status for remote procedure.

methods.name: llcp_rr_ispaused
methods.description: Checks if remote procedure is paused.

methods.name: llcp_pdu_decode_chan_map_update_ind
methods.description: Decodes a channel map update indication PDU.

methods.name: is_instant_reached_or_passed
methods.description: Checks if the instant has been reached or passed.

methods.name: is_instant_not_passed
methods.description: Checks if the instant has not passed.
